fix: When a Grammar combines flags with passthrough args, see if an unrecognized flag may be treated as a positional argument (#435)

* ci: Add a test for positional args that are passthrough on a command that isn't passthrough

* fix: When a Grammar combines flags with passthrough args, see if an unrecognized flag may be treated as a positional argument

Given a grammar like this:
```golang
var cli struct {
	Args []string `arg:"" optional:"" passthrough:""`
}
```

The first positional argument implies that it was preceded by `--`, so subsequent flags are not parsed.

If Kong parses `cli 1 --unknown 3`, it will populate `Args` with `[]string{"1", "--unknown", "3"}`.
However, if Kong parses `cli --unknown 2 3`, it will fail saying that `--unknown` is an unrecognized flag.

This commit changes the parser so that if an unknown flag _could_ be treated as the first passthrough argument, it is.

After this change, if Kong parses `cli --unknown 2 3`, it will populate `Args` with `[]string{"--unknown", "2", "3"}`.

* ci: Skip the `maintidx` linter for `trace()`

pr.title: fix: When a Grammar combines flags with passthrough args, see if an unrecognized flag may be treated as a positional argument
pr.body:
### Issue
Given a grammar like this:
```golang
var cli struct {
        Args []string `arg:"" optional:"" passthrough:""`
}
```

The first positional argument implies that it was preceded by `--`, so subsequent flags are not parsed.

If Kong parses `cli 1 --unknown 3`, it will populate `Args` with `[]string{"1", "--unknown", "3"}`.
However, if Kong parses `cli --unknown 2 3`, it will fail saying that `--unknown` is an unrecognized flag.

### Proposal
This commit changes the parser so that if an unknown flag _could_ be treated as the first passthrough argument, it is.

After this change, if Kong parses `cli --unknown 2 3`, it will populate `Args` with `[]string{"--unknown", "2", "3"}`.

explanation.what: Context.trace() でフラグ解析(parseFlag)が失敗した際、次に来るはずの positional 引数が passthrough:"" 指定なら、その未知フラグをフラグではなく先頭のpassthrough位置引数として扱うよう変更した。判定用に unknownFlagError 型(Unwrap 実装済み)を新設し、parseFlag の未知フラグエラーをこの型でラップして errors.As で検出できるようにした。.golangci.yml には trace() 用の maintidx 除外設定も追加している。
explanation.why: PR本文の通り、`Args []string \`arg:"" optional:"" passthrough:""\`` のような文法で、先頭にpositional引数を1つ挟んでから未知フラグを渡す(`cli 1 --unknown 3`)場合は素通りするのに、いきなり未知フラグから始める(`cli --unknown 2 3`)場合はエラーになるという非対称な挙動を修正するため。

highlights.note: FlagToken/ShortFlagToken の解析失敗時に isUnknownFlagError で判定し、passthrough位置引数側に振り替えるロジック

langNotes.topic: errors.As と カスタムエラー型のUnwrap
langNotes.note: Go の error wrapping パターン。unknownFlagError に Unwrap() error を実装することで、呼び出し側は errors.As(err, &unknown) で「このエラーが unknownFlagError かどうか」を、ラップの層をまたいで判定できる。
